categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded after goods receipt
categories.description: Item is resolved via 3-way matching where the invoice is recorded after goods receipt. This process makes value-matching control integrity (+100) while incurring procurement and matching overhead (-25). Performance is judged against Indicator 17 (Time to clearance, 3-way after GR, days) and Indicator 20 (3-way matching compliance).
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=5 in the goal model. This path is evidenced by frequent variants such as V0001, V0002, V0004, and V0005 where goods receipt precedes invoice recording.

categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded before goods receipt
categories.description: Item is resolved via 3-way matching where the invoice is recorded before goods receipt. This process helps preserve value-matching control integrity (+50) and helps maximize working-capital efficiency (+50). Performance is judged against Indicator 18 (Time to clearance, 3-way before GR, days) and Indicator 20.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=6 in the goal model. Evidenced by variants such as V0007 and V0008 where invoice receipt occurs before goods receipt.

categories.name: 2-way matched (no goods receipt required)
categories.description: Item is resolved via 2-way matching where no goods receipt is required. This process helps minimize procurement and matching overhead (+50) with some negative impact on control integrity (-25). Performance is judged against Indicator 19 (Time to clearance, 2-way match, days).
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=7 in the goal model. Service-oriented and goods-free variants like V0064 and V0068 reflect this execution pattern.

categories.name: Resolve via consignment consumption
categories.description: Item is resolved via consignment consumption. This path helps minimize procurement and matching overhead (+50) while having some negative impact on control integrity (-25). Performance is judged against overall exception and clearance metrics.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=13 in the goal model. This specific approach represents alternative resolution regimes present in specialized supply scenarios.
